[b][size=4][b][size=4]Overview[/size][/b][/size][/b]
Anthro Cat Miku turns [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29201]Miku Mod Plus[/url]'s﻿ Miku into a blue cat.
While technically not required, it was made to be used alongside [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Anthro Characters Continued[/url].
Includes Portraits and Overworld sprites and Tile set!

[b][size=4][b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b][/size][/b][list=1]
[*]﻿Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29201]Miku Mod Plus[/url]﻿
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Anthro Characters Continued[/url]﻿
[*]Download this mod's file.
[*]Extract the downloaded file into your Stardew Valley's "mods" folder

[*]Drag it into the mod folder, and agree to the overwrites.

[*]Select “[b](CP) Miku Mod Plus[/b]” from the mod config.

[*]Select “[b]OldModType[/b]” from the “Vanilla Portrait Change” menu, and if the portrait has changed, you have succeeded!


[/list][b][size=4][b][size=3]Other Notes[/size][/b][/size][/b]
This is my first mod and was improvised, so there may be some rough edges that stand out.
The events of the Miku mod have not been tested yet, so we plan to make improvements and corrections as we play with it.
We would like to be able to add mod settings later on, and if possible, add changes of clothes for each specific season/event! Please contact me if you have any ideas.
